notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Ornithopter.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.
